capabilities: Log all notices to the developer console
Add an optional prefix and timestamp to logged notices
extras: The Demo and Settings tab sections in the README are empty; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian notices are transient on-screen messages that vanish, so developers have no built-in way to capture them for debugging.
summary: Developer utility that logs all Obsidian notices to the developer console, with an optional prefix and timestamp.
